text:
alex: Heads up — CI on main turned red, failing snapshot/golden tests for prompt-renderer (test_prompt_snapshot). Diff looks like spacing/serialization drift, not an obvious logic error. Anyone seen this yet?

ci-bot: [CI] build #4823 failed: tests/prompt_renderer_test.py::test_prompt_snapshot — see artifacts: https://ci.internal/reports/4823 

sam: I pulled the artifact — the diff is largely extra spaces around punctuation in the generated prompt. small but causes snapshot mismatch. Could be tokenizer normalization change or prompt-joining logic.

maria: Wasn't there a recent PR touching prompt normalization? @sam I think PR #3245 touched prompt normalization and serializer v2.

sam: yeah PR #3245 by @maria — it normalized newlines and collapsed double spaces. That might explain the mismatch if we changed how we join system/user messages.

alex: Can someone bisect? If it's that PR we either update the golden (if intended) or revert the normalization. Need quick triage because this is blocking deploy.

jamie: I can start with a local repro first. Commands that usually work for me:```bash
# run just the snapshot test locally
pytest tests/prompt_renderer_test.py::test_prompt_snapshot -q
# to get the generated snapshot
python tools/generate_golden.py --target prompt_renderer > /tmp/gen.txt
# show unified diff
git --no-pager diff --no-index -U3 tests/golden/prompt_renderer.golden /tmp/gen.txt
```

leo: If someone wants to bisect on CI:```bash
git bisect start HEAD v1.3.0
git bisect run ./scripts/ci_run_golden.sh tests/prompt_renderer_test.py::test_prompt_snapshot
```I can take the bisect if no one else is on it.

alex: thanks leo — please go ahead. If it points at #3245 we'll discuss update vs revert.

infra-bot: Note: rerun queue length = 12, estimated time ~20m for bisect on CI.

leo: starting bisect now, will update thread with findings. :eyes:

(20m later)

leo: bisect finished — culprit commit is 6a1f3d2 (maria) which introduced prompt normalization changes in serializer v2. Confirmed by checking that reverting that hunk makes the golden match.

maria: yep that was the one. The normalization was intentional to make prompts stable across client variants, but we didn't update the golden fixtures. Looks like intended behavior.

sam: if behavior is intended, we should update the golden snapshots and add a note to changelog. Also add a small test asserting normalized spacing to avoid regressions in the other direction.

alex: Agreed. Can someone prepare a PR that regenerates the golden and includes a short test? Keep commit message documenting the normalization change.

jamie: I'll open the PR. Steps I used to regenerate locally:```bash
# run with snapshot update
pytest tests/prompt_renderer_test.py::test_prompt_snapshot -q --snapshot-update
# or
python tools/generate_golden.py --target prompt_renderer > tests/golden/prompt_renderer.golden
git add tests/golden/prompt_renderer.golden
git commit -m "update prompt_renderer golden to match serializer v2 normalization (6a1f3d2)"
```
I'll include a unit that asserts no double spaces remain after serialize.

sam: also add a short note in the release checklist so Dedicated/private customers know about the change if they rely on exact prompt bytes.

maria: thanks — sorry for the noise, should've flagged golden bump in the PR. Will review the regen PR.

alex: great — once PR is merged i'll re-run CI. For tracking: file an internal task to add the normalization behavior to docs and to the eval harness so downstream prompts are comparable.

leo: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/commit/PR-4567 — regen + test.

ci-bot: [CI] PR-4567 triggered build #4830 — running tests.

jamie: merging once green and we've got a quick signoff from @maria and @sam.

alex: thanks everyone — closing thread after green CI. :thumbsup:
